Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the run chase. The players have made their way to the middle. Nizakat Khan and Yasim Murtaza are the openers for Hong Kong and will be looking for a good start. Naseem Shah has been handed the new ball and he will begin proceedings. Lets go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, the Pakistan bowling attack is in great form and could prove to be quite a handful for the Hong Kong batters. They have a huge target to defend and will want to go through the motions and get wickets early. Hong Kong has shown glimpses of batting talent and will be hoping to get off to the a flier. Join us shortly for the run chase.

Fakhar Zaman is up for a chat. He says that the plan was to play according to the wicket. He says that the pitch in Sharjah is on the slow side and they decided to take their time in the first 10 overs and then go all out in the next. Adds that the wicket here tends to be on the lower side but is happy how his side adjusted to it and posted a big total on the board.

Hong Kong were off to a great start once again bowling with discipline and exploiting the conditions on offer. Nizakat Khan did well to shuffle his bowlers around and keep the pressure on their opponents. They kept the much-fancied Pakistan top order shackled and did not let them get off to an explosive start. They picked up the wicket of the Pakistani captain early and there was a spring in their step thereafter. Despite keeping it tight for long periods they were unable to take wickets and it was only a matter of time before the onslaught would begin. They conceded just 64 runs in the first ten overs but the next ten overs yielded 129 runs. Ehsan Khan was once again the pick of the bowlers taking the only wicket in the Powerplay and then returning in the death overs to break the 100-run plus stand, conceding just 28 runs in full quota of four overs. They lost their discipline towards the end and conceded far too many extras.

Pakistan stuck to their plans and got off to a watchful start scoring just 40 runs in the Powerplay. Babar Azam was dismissed early and his opening partner Mohammad Rizwan continued to occupy the crease without showing too much intent. Fakhar Zaman came to the wicket and looked to get settled in but began building a steady partnership with Rizwan. The latter reached his half-century in 42 deliveries which could be considered slightly slow in this format. He did pick up the ante after getting to his fifty and added a 116-run second-wicket partnership with Fakhar Zaman who was dismissed on 53. Mohammad Rizwan struggled with fitness throughout the innings but powered through to make 78 runs in 57 balls. Khushdil Shah proved to be the difference as he hammered four sixes in the last over that yielded 29 runs. He scored 35 runs in 15 balls and shared a 64-run partnership with Rizwan in just 23 balls courtesy of some extras as well.

We witnessed some serious fireworks from Pakistan towards the end. They have managed to reach a commanding total of 193 on a relatively difficult surface. They will know that they have enough firepower in their bowling department to defend this total. Hong Kong showed good fight initially and at one stage it looked like they could restrict their opponents to under 150 after the start they had. They will now have to bat out of their skins to get to this target.

SIX! Finishes with another maximum! Massive over, 29 from it! Aizaz Khan just lost it completely after bowling two dot balls at the start of this over. He bowls a short one, easy pickings for Khushdil Shah as it is around leg. Shah just pulls it over deep backward square leg for the fourth maximum of this over. Pakistan finish with 193/2 after 20 overs!
SIX! Two in a row now! Aizaz Khan overcompensates this time. Bowls it full and in the slot for Khushdil Shah. He gets under it and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
SIX! Khushdil Shah with another biggie! This is why he was sent over Asif Ali! A shorter-length delivery again. Shah stays deep in his crease and pumps it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.

FIVE WIDES! Ohh...he started this over so well but is crumbling under pressure now. Bowls a short one and way down the leg side. Shah leaves it and keeper fails to stop it as he dives to his right. The ball runs away towards the fence.
SIX! Finally, Khushdil Shah connects! Khan bowls a slower short ball, on off. Shah was waiting for it and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
This one is quick! A short one, around off. Shah looks to cut it this time but gets beaten by the pace this time.
Starts off with a lovely delivery! Bowls a length delivery, a cutter this time. Shah goes for a big swing across the line but misses as he is too early on his shot.
Aizaz Khan will bowl the final over. He has conceded 15 runs in his two overs.
Just a couple to end the over! Fires it on middle. Rizwan uses his feet again and flicks it towards cow corner for two runs. Can Hong Kong keep Pakistan under 175 here?
Ehsan Khan bowls it quicker and flatter, no room for the batter again. Rizwan dances down the track and clips it to deep mid-wicket for two more.
Nails a yorker, on off. Shah digs it out to long off for a single. What an over this has been, simply brilliant.
On middle and flatter again. Rizwan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for just a single again.
Very good fielding at long on! A full delivery on off. Shah drills it to right of long on. The fielder there runs to his right and dives to stop it. Keeps it to just a single.
A low full toss on off. Rizwan whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

A dot end the over then! This is a good yorker and on leg, angling in, Khushdil Shah goes for the flick but gets and inside edge onto his pads and the ball goes back towards the bowler. 18 runs from the over!

FIVE WIDES! This is turning out to be a huge over for Pakistan. Ayush Shukla tries to bowl the off cutter but loses his line again and spills it way down the leg side. The ball dies on his way towards the keeper and Scott McKechnie lets it through his legs. It races away to the fence.
Bangs it short, on middle. Rizwan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Excellent running! Almost nails a yorker, on middle. Rizwan just digs it out towards mid on and Rizwan calls for two straightaway. Shah hesitates for a bit but completes the second run easily in the end.
Bangs it short again, on middle. Shah pulls it bit uppishly but it is well short of fine leg and a single is taken.
WIDE! He is struggling here youngman. Bowls a slower short ball that is way down the leg side. Shah leaves it alone.
On a length and drifts down the leg side again. Shah tries to clip it away but misses and the ball brushes his pads before rolling towards the keeper.

SIX! This is what Khushdil Shah is known for and he has pumped this over long off. A full delivery on off. In the slot and Shah launches it over long off for a biggie. Plenty of advice for the bowler now.
WIDE! Another wide. Short and slower again, down the leg side. Shah looks to pull it but misses.
WIDE! Ayush Shukla starts his new spell with a slower delivery. It lands on a length and drifts down the leg side. Shah looks to clip it away but misses.
Ayush Shukla is back on. Two overs for 15 runs so far.
Full and on middle, Khushdil Shah tucks it towards mid-wicket for one.

Again well played by Rizwan! This darted full and on a yorker length, on off, Mohammad Rizwan opens the face of his bat and squeezes it towards the third man fence. The fielder from short third man gives a chase, puts in a dive and keeps it in. Three runs taken.

FOUR! Clever from Rizwan! This is flatter and quicker, on off, Mohammad Rizwan shuffles across and scoops it well using the pace of the ball. The ball goes over the short fine leg fielder and races away to the fence.
A low full toss and on middle, Khushdil Shah drills it towards long on for one and gets off the mark.
Good yorker! Bowls it on off. Shah digs it out to the left of the bowler.
Khushdil Shah walks out at number 4!

OUT! TAKEN! Ehsan Khan comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway. He sent Fakhar Zaman back to the hut who was looking dangerous. He tosses this up outside off, Fakhar Zaman again dances down the track and makes it a full toss, he slashes hard at it but straight to the hands of Aizaz Khan who is stationed at point. He makes no mistake and the partnership has been broken.
Commentary.Howout: c Aizaz Khan b Ehsan Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Ehsan Khan is back on. Two overs for 11 runs and a wicket for him.
Flighted, full and on middle, Fakhar Zaman uses his feet and goes for the slog but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for one. Back to back good overs for Pakistan.
Looped up and around middle, Fakhar Zaman pushes it back to the bowler.

SIX! Fakhar Zaman reaches to his fifty in some style! He is taking on Yasim Murtaza now! This is floated and around middle, Fakhar Zaman dances down the track, did not get to the pitch of it but still hammers it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum. This has been a good innings and he will look to score runs quickly now.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Slower through the air, on middle, turning in, Fakhar Zaman flicks it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Powered away! This is short and outside off, Fakhar Zaman makes room and slaps it wide of the long off fence for a boundary.
Quicker one, on middle, keeps a bit low, Fakhar Zaman uses his feet and works it towards mid-wicket for a single. 12 runs from the over then. Pakistan are changing gears now.
SIX! Fakhar Zaman connects this one alright and sends it into the stands! This is looped up, full and on middle, Fakhar Zaman goes down and heaves it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan bunts it towards deep point for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Fakhar Zaman skips down the track and slaps it straight to long on for one more.
Darted full and on the pads, Mohammad Rizwan eases it towards long on for a single.
Shorter and angling into the batter, Mohammad Rizwan goes back and tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Slower through the air, around off. Rizwan sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single and retains the strike. 11 from this over.
Mohammad Rizwan is feeling a bit sick due to the heat and takes a break. The umpires are telling him to hurry up. Now, everything seems fine and we are ready to continue.
Touch shorter in length, on middle. Rizwan clips it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run. Good running here again but they need boundaries more often from hereon.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Bit quicker through the air, on middle. Rizwan gets low and slog-sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Very slow through the air again. Fakhar Zaman advances down the track and Yasim Murtaza very cleverly drags his length back. Fakhar Zaman only manages to knock it to long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on middle. Fakhar Zaman slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.

Fifty for Mohammad Rizwan! He has taken the resposibility of batting till the end after the dismissal of Babar Azam early. However, he needs to up the ante now. This delivery, is tad short of full length. It turns away a bit and Rizwan pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Yasim Murtaza is back on. He has conceded just 12 runs in his 2 overs.
So, 10 from this over! Single to end it. On middle and fuller. Rizwan uses his feet and nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played this time! Good placement. On the shorter side and outside off. Rizwan rocks back and cuts it through cover-point for a boundary.

Inside edge this time but goes through the legs of Scott McKechnie, the keeper! A flatter one and outside off. Rizwan tries to cut it but gets the inside edge and the ball goes between the two legs of the keeper as he fails to get his gloves down in time. Two taken as the ball goes behind the keeper.
Tad shorter and on leg. Fakhar Zaman clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Another ground shot! Another flatter delivery on middle. Rizwan skips down the track and knocks it to long off for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the track and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
So, another single to end the over! Goes fuller on middle. Fakhar Zaman whips it to long on for a single.
Serves a length delivery on middle again. Rizwan clips it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Lands it on a length and outside off. Fakhar Zaman pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

TWO WIDES! Bowls it on a length and down the leg side. Rizwan looks to flick it but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly as well and the batters run an extra run off the wide ball as the ball goes towards short fine leg.
Fakhar Zaman walks down the pitch and pushes this length delivery towards point for a single.
On a length, on middle. Rizwan clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! Aizaz Khan bowls it short and around off. Rizwan tries to pull it away but misses. The keeper, Scott McKechnie is standing up for the seamer here and collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. They appeal for the stumping and the leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and Rizwan is safe here as his feet is inside the crease when the bails were whipped off.
Aizaz Khan (1-0-8-0) come back into the attack.
On middle and it is a googly this time. Rizwan clips it to deep square leg for a single. 12 from the over!

SIX! Finally, Mohammad Rizwan clears the fence! First six of the game! Mohammad Ghazanfar tosses this up, on middle. Mohammad Rizwan uses his feet, reaches the pitch of the ball and launches it straight down the ground for a maximum.
Still a single! Mohammad Ghazanfar continues to bowl the fuller length, on middle. Fakhar Zaman dances down the track and powers it to long on for a single.
Goes fuller on middle. Fakhar Zaman slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Tries to hit it hard again but just a single as he drills it to long off for a single. Showing intent now, Pakistan!
Tossed up, on middle. Fakhar Zaman dances down the track and hammers it to long on. The fielder fumbles a bit and Fakhar Zaman looks for the second run but Rizwan sends him back in time.

Drinks break. Hong Kong have done well here to keep the lid on the scoring rate. They got the big wicket of Babar Azam early and have bowled good tight lines and lengths here. They, however, need to keep this going in the next 10 overs as well. Pakistan, on the other hand, need to up the ante here. Both the batters are set now and there is plenty of batting to come. They would be eyeing at least over 150 from hereon.
Shorter and on middle, Fakhar Zaman stays back and flicks it towards mid-wicket for one more. Six singles in the over then.
Mohammad Rizwan again plays the sweep to this full delivery outside off towards sqaure leg for a single.
A bit short and on off, Fakhar Zaman goes back and pushes it towards short third man for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan sweeps it through square leg for one more.
Fakhar Zaman skips down the track and Yasim Murtaza pulls his length back a bit. On middle and slower through the air. Fakhar Zaman clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan mistimes his sweep towards short fine leg for one.
Yasim Murtaza to continue after giving away just 6 runs in his first over.

NOT OUT! Fakhar Zaman survives and a very good review taken by Pakistan. This is tossed up full and on middle and leg, Fakhar Zaman goes down and tries to slog-sweep it but misses and gets hit on his pads. There is an appeal for LBW and the finger goes up. Fakhar Zaman opts for the review. The UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved but Ball Tracking shows that it is pitching outside leg. The on field decision is changed to Not Out.
Full and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan steps out and drills it towards long on for a single.
Bowls it flatter and quicker, around off. Rizwan defends it to the left of the bowler and looks for a single initially but decides against it.
Flatter and quicker on off, Mohammad Rizwan opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a brace.
Flaoted, short and on leg, Fakhar Zaman flicks it towards square leg for one more.
Tossed up and around middle, Fakhar Zaman blocks it out.

This is flighted and on off, turning in a bit, Mohammad Rizwan looks to block it but gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball loops up to the right of the keeper. The keeper dives to that side and collects the ball. They appeal for the catch but the finger stays down. The umpires sends it upstairs to check the catch and the replays shows that the keeper collected it on the bounce. The on field decision of Not Out remains.
Nicely tossed up, around off, Fakhar Zaman uses his feet and works it towards wide long on for one.
Floated, full and on off, turning in, Fakhar Zaman blocks it to the left of the bowler.
A bit short and on off, Mohammad Rizwan goes back and pushes it towards covers for one.

FOUR! Nicely played! This is tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan goes down and sweeps it. His bottom hand comes off the handle as he plays this shot and the ball races away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary. This should release some pressure now.
Starts with a looped up delivery, full and on off, Mohammad Rizwan knocks it off his inner half to the leg side.
Yasim Murtaza is into the attack now. The left-arm spinner bowls very slow in the air and let's see how he goes about his business today.
Full again and on off, Mohammad Rizwan drives it through covers for another run. 8 runs from the over then.
Fuller one and on middle, Mohammad Rizwan moves across and works it towards the vacant mid-wicket region for a brace.
This is short and on middle, sticks to the surface a bit, Fakhar Zaman goes for the pull hot but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball deflects of his pads to the off side and they get a run.
Goes fuller and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan stays there and crunches it towards sweeper cover but just for one.
On a length and around off, Fakhar Zaman guides it towards backward point for a quick single.
WIDE! He loses his line and bowls this way down the leg side. Fakhar Zaman misses his flick. Wided.
Aizaz Khan starts with a slower full delivery, on off, Mohammad Rizwan tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Aizaz Khan is into the attack now.

Ehsan Khan goes 'round the wicket and bowls this quick. Fires this one into the pads on a fuller length, Fakhar Zaman clips the ball to the left of the bowler. Pakistan are 40 for 1 at the end of the Powerplay.

Fires this one full and angled into the pads, Mohammad Rizwan clips the ball towards deep mid-wicket for a single. The call was for two but they have to settle for one as the fielder does well in the deep.
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander and bowls this a fraction short outside off, Mohammad Rizwan looks to play this late but misses.
This is closer to the off pole and served full once again, Fakhar Zaman dabs this towards short third man and takes a quick single.
Ehsan Khan loops this outside off, Fakhar Zaman shimmies down the wicket and works the ball through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Flights this one full and angled into the left-hander. Fakhar Zaman blocks this towards mid on.
Ehsan Khan is back to bowl the last over of the Powerplay.

FOUR! This has been delicately played! Ayush Shukla continues to bowls this wide outside off on a good length. Mohammad Rizwan gets some bat on this and the ball trickles down to third man. The fielder puts in a dive and reaches it but the ball pops out of his hands and rolls away towards the fence. That is four more runs added to Mohammad Rizwan's kitty.

The wicket-keeper is up at the stumps. Ayush Shukla bowls this really wide outside off and on a good length. Mohammad Rizwan looks to work this fine but gets beaten. The keeper does not collect cleanly.

FOUR! This has been slapped away! Ayush Shukla bowls this short and outside the off stump, Mohammad Rizwan gets on top of the ball and finds the gap in the off side. The ball flies to the deep cover-point fence for four cracking runs.
Bowls this on a good length and outside the off stump, Fakhar Zaman guides the ball to third man and takes a run.
This is full and angling into the pads, Mohammad Rizwan clips this to deep square leg and takes a single.
Ayush Shukla bowls this back of a length and outside off, Mohammad Rizwan gets across the stumps and looks to pull. Gets hit high on the pads and there is a stifled appeal.
Hong Kong are rotating their bowlers here. Ayush Shukla replaces Ehsan Khan now.

FOUR! Fakhar Zaman finds the placement! Haroon Arshad bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Fakhar Zaman pulls this to the right of short fine leg and the ball rushes to the deep backward square leg fence for four runs.
Haroon Arshad bowls full once again and just outside off, Mohammad Rizwan flicks this wide of mid on and takes another quick run.

Haroon Arshad bowls this full and outside off, Fakhar Zaman hits this straight to cover and takes off for a quick single. Mohammad Rizwan is ball-watching and there is hesitation. The throw is at the non-striker's end and Fakhar Zaman would have been a goner if it was a direct hit. A single in the end.
Haroon Arshad bowls this back of a length and outside off, takes some pace off the ball. Fakhar Zaman is early into the shot and misses. Dot ball on a Free Hit.

NO BALL! Decides to go 'round the wicket this time and serves this beyond the tram line on the off side. The umpire calls wide once more. Wait a moment. He has overstepped and it is now called no ball. Free Hit incoming.
WIDE! Haroon Arshad tries to keep this away from the left-hander and angles this well outside off on a fuller length. Fakhar Zaman leaves it alone and is called wide by the umpire.

FOUR! That has been put away to the fence! Haroon Arshad bowls this one full as well and outside off, Fakhar Zaman thumps the ball towards deep cover for a boundary. That should release some pressure.
Haroon Arshad begins this over with a full delivery really wide outside off, Fakhar Zaman will feel he missed out and he strokes this straight to cover.
Haroon Arshad (1-0-2-0) comes back into the attack now.
Fires this one full and into the pads of the left-hander. Fakhar Zaman clips the ball to deep square leg and takes a single to get off the mark immediately.
Fakhar Zaman walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Pakistan lose their skipper and Hong Kong have a huge wicket! Ehsan Khan flights this one full and on middle, Babar Azam looks to work this leg side but is early into his shot. He lobs the ball towards the bowler and Ehsan Khan dives forward to his right and takes a wonderful catch. Hong Kong have drawn first blood and they will be pumped.

FOUR! That will be the first boundary for Pakistan! Ehsan Khan bowls this short and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam pulls this towards deep backward square leg for four runs. This should get Pakistan going.
This is full as well and outside the off pole, Mohammad Rizwan uses his wrists and works the ball to long on for another single.
Goes full and just outside the off stump, Mohammad Rizwan clips the ball to mid-wicket.
Ehsan Khan bowls this a fraction short and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam rocks back and thumps the ball to long on for a single.
We will see some spin now as Ehsan Khan replaces Haroon Arshad.
Bowls this on full and in line with the middle stump, Babar Azam clips the ball to the right of mid-wicket and takes a single to keep strike.
Pulls his length back slightly and serves this outside off, Mohammad Rizwan works this to deep backward point and takes one.
This is a fraction fuller and outside off, Babar Azam mistimes his shot straight to cover.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps, Babar Azam tucks this to deep square leg for another single.

This is full and in line with the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan charges down the wicket and looks to drive it away. However, he gets an inside half of his blade and the ball goes towards deep square leg. A single taken.

Ayush Shukla begins with delivery bowled on good length in line with off stump. Babar Azam hits this straight back at the bowler who cant get his hands to it. They take a single as mid off comes and cuts off the ball.
Ayush Shukla comes into the attack now.
Bowls this full and outside off, Babar Azam gets the bottom half of his bat on the ball and takes a quick single as the ball goes to the gully region. Just 2 runs from the first over.
On a good length once again and just outside off, Babar Azam blocks the ball back towards the bowler who parries it away towards mid on.
Haroon Arshad bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole, Mohammad Rizwan guides this to deep backward point for a single and gets off the mark.
Goes full once again and angles this into the stumps, Mohammad Rizwan flicks the ball towards mid on. Three dot balls now.
This is outside off as well but bowled a touch fuller, Mohammad Rizwan mistimes his shot towards cover-point.
Haroon Arshad begins with a good-length delivery served outside off stump, Mohammad Rizwan knocks this towards point.

So, it is time for the real action to begin now! The Hong Kong players are in the huddle and they disperse now to take their respective positions. Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan are the openers for Pakistan. Both of them have been quite prolific at the top of the order for Pakistan in T20Is. Can they fire again in this game? Let's find out as Haroon Arshad is ready to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

The players make their way out to the middle now. It is time for the national anthems! It will be Hong Kong's first followed by the Pakistan anthem. Huge roar from the crowd as we are done with the national anthems now.

Pitch Report - Sanjay Manjrekar is down for the pitch report. He says that the pitch has an interesting color and there has been a bit of watering done. Feels that the ball may stop on the batters. Claims that the first three big-name players of Pakistan will possibly get more runs. Adds that the bounce is low and Naseem Shah may be able to exploit it. Informs that for Hong Kong, the spin bowlers may have some purchase but not much. Says it is a great opportunity to bat first and there are a lot of runs for the batters at the top.

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan says that they would have batted first anyway. Adds that the plan is to put runs on the board and then defend it. Mentions that every game is a new game and they need to stick to their strengths. Ends by saying that it was a tight game against India and they will look to execute their plans well in this one. Informs they have made no changes.

Nizakat Khan, the skipper of Hong Kong says that they will bowl again. Tells that the reason for that is they are good at chasing and they are looking to play to their strengths today. Mentions that they rely on spin and this pitch will help them. Adds that they played well till the 13th over in the last game but credits Suryakumar for the way he played and they are looking to do well in this game. Informs that they are playing the same eleven.

Hong Kong (Unchanged Playing XI) - Nizakat Khan (C), Yasim Murtaza, Babar Hayat, Kinchit Shah, Aizaz Khan, Zeeshan Ali, Scott McKechnie (WK), Haroon Arshad, Ehsan Khan, Ayush Shukla, Mohammad Ghazanfar.
Pakistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Shadab Khan, Asif Ali, Mohammad Nawaz, Haris Rauf, Naseem Shah, Shahnawaz Dahani.
TOSS - The captains and the match referee are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Hong Kong. They have elected to BOWL first.

Hong Kong are also coming into this game with a loss against India in their opening encounter. They tried their best in that game but India's quality proved too much for them. Although there were some positives for them as their middle order performed well. Babar Hayat, Nizakat Khan with the bat and Ehsan Khan with the ball will be important for them. They will look to bring their qualifier's form in this one and give a tough fight to Pakistan. Toss and further updates coming up.
